fact_notes: Book 1 title, subtitle and tagline: from the Book 1 cover supplied by the author.
Book 1 is on Amazon: stated by the author in chat.
Book 2 launches this week: stated by the author in chat.
Book 2 title, subtitle, 'Book 2 of The Australia Renewal Series', back-cover copy and 'Inside you'll learn' list: from the Book 2 cover supplied by the author.
Lines 1-2 paraphrase the Book 2 back-cover blurb ('Hiring slows. Rates rise... kitchen-table maths that no longer adds up').
Five rate rises in 2026: the book's own claim, per its back cover; the film quotes the book, not an independent fact.

Author bio (line 14): back cover says network and security architect, small-business owner, home builder; delivered technology and infrastructure projects for Australian government and energy organisations; built businesses in hospitality and construction.
